message:
fix(diagnostics): verify user tool-path overrides against the filesystem (#363) (#435)

withPathOverride reported any non-empty override as 検出済み, so a typo'd MuseScore/FFmpeg path looked healthy until the export subprocess failed. New probe_tool_path Tauri command + shared resolveToolWithOverride probe the real path and report 未検出 (keeping the offending path visible). ShellDiagnosticsPort.collect now also reports real detect_tools results instead of blanket unknown, honouring the same verified overrides. The blind merge remains only as the no-bridge/browser fallback.

Co-authored-by: Devin <158243242+devin-ai-integration[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
